name: Multi-format, multi-file upload with a live roster
evidence: Ingest reads CSV/TSV/TXT (.gz/.zst), Parquet, Excel and SAS XPT (datastore.py:48-51; DoD:25). XPT is new compared with Classic. The start screen takes one file per upload: StartScreen.tsx:15 TABLE_EXT, :166-171 upload.mutate(file), :210 accept list with no 'multiple'. The server can add files for joining (server/routes/assembly.py:64 upload_file), and the client has uploadFile/joinPreview (client.ts:251-259), but no component calls them (frontend_inventory gaps[6]).
gap: No JSON/JSONL (see C01-03). The screen has no multi-file roster with rename, remove or replace. The added-file engine and route exist, but nothing on screen reaches them.

name: Excel sheet picker with a parse-time estimate
evidence: Only the first sheet is read; the code warns 'the workbook has N sheets; only the first ... was read' (datastore.py:948-950). That warning goes to DatasetInfo.warnings (datastore.py:126), which no frontend component renders (grep of turbotab/frontend/src finds only design warnings).
gap: No sheet picker and no parse-time estimate. On screen the other sheets are dropped without a visible notice.

name: JSON layout reader
evidence: The definition of done lists the v2 upload formats as 'CSV, TSV, Parquet, Excel, SAS XPT' (V2_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md:25), and new scope enters only by displacing something on the list (V2_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md:3-4). SUPPORTED_TYPES (datastore.py:50-51) and TABLE_EXT (StartScreen.tsx:15) contain no JSON.
gap: This is out of scope by the DoD's format list, not by a ruling that names JSON. Records lists, wrapped payloads, JSON Lines and nested-field flattening are all absent.

name: Transpose on import
evidence: Orientation is read from header tokens and feature-name grammar first, then from a scale-aware shape. It is never claimed at high confidence, and the user turns the table (orientation.py:1-22). Duplicate feature names that would collapse into one column are refused with code duplicate_features (working.py:660-670). OrientationAsk (SequenceQuestions.tsx:41) and TurnTable.tsx draw the question; its feature-table exits are partial (frontend_inventory gaps[24]).
gap: The omics feature-table exits (set_feature_table) have no control (gaps[24], gaps[68]).

name: Memory-aware admission gate (files and combined tables)
evidence: Ingest is columnar and out of core, so a file never has to fit in RAM to be admitted (BLUEPRINT.md:99-109). Materializing is checked against a budget of 50% of available RAM (config.py:6). Exceeding it raises MemoryBudgetExceeded with the estimate, the budget and the advice to use server mode (datastore.py:150-161). The profile falls back to a fixed sample and says so (stages/data.py:78-97). The findings stage fails with the budget's message rather than sampling (stages/findings.py:13-15).
gap: Nothing is admitted, warned about or refused at upload, and there is no estimate before a join. A table too large to materialize surfaces as a stage error during the opening sequence, not as a pre-flight verdict.

name: Add-all bulk ingest
v2_engine_at: turbotab/core/assembly.py:410-431 (files are added one at a time for joins)
evidence: A project is created from one file (StartScreen.tsx:166-171). Further files exist only as join partners through the added-file route (server/routes/assembly.py:64), and no component calls it (frontend_inventory gaps[6]).
gap: No bulk 'add all' and no per-file added/failed/warnings report. This depends on the multi-file UI in C01-01.

name: Built-in practice datasets
evidence: StartScreen.tsx offers open-by-path and upload only; a grep for 'sample', 'example' or 'demo' finds nothing. Reference fixtures exist under turbotab/sample_data (for example clinical_labs.csv). In local mode they can be reached only by browsing to their path.
gap: There is no one-click demo or teaching dataset.

name: Import Doctor: structural diagnosis with reversible one-click repairs
evidence: The findings stage still runs Classic's ml.import_doctor.diagnose (engine.py:154-155; stages/findings.py:5-8). Repairs exist for sentinel codes, text read as numbers, SAS zeros, binary text, kJ, values below detection, infinities, date reading and impossible values (repairs.py:16-38, 1120-1146). Each repair is row-local, carries a methods sentence and can be undone by revert (Record.tsx:778-782). Sentinel detection is stricter than Classic's: a code must sit beyond every other value with a gap and recur (detectors/codes.py:1-38). Unnamed and constant columns route to roles as 'Mark as excluded' (finding_words.py:180-195). Duplicate headers are renamed at ingest (datastore.py:304-321). Repairs.tsx and Findings.tsx draw all of this.
gap: Several findings are diagnosed but offer no fix ('No control for this yet.', repairs.py:103; finding_words.py:952-953): a header in a later row, footer rows, empty rows or columns, category spelling variants, and wide repeated measures (no melt). A header-row finding also masks the per-column checks (detectors/codes.py:252-262). There is no 'Undo all fixes' button.

name: Combine files: the relation question, with the app's guess
evidence: Only joins are modeled. The contract asks 'Which file joins this table, and on which identifier?' with the options left and inner (assembly.py:55-68). Minimal assembly is defined as joining on a shared identifier (V2_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md:40-42).
gap: There is no plain-language relation question (link, stack, both or one file), no column-overlap guess, and no stacking. The join UI is unbuilt (gaps[6]).

name: Join Doctor: key detection from values, with a pre-join diagnosis
evidence: The plan counts one-to-one, one-to-many and many-to-one joins and refuses many-to-many with an exit (assembly.py:8-18). Blank and NaN identifiers never match (assembly.py:25-28, 202-209). Unmatched rows are counted on each side, and a colliding column is renamed <name>_<file stem> (assembly.py:29-30). Mismatched identifier types are refused, not repaired (assembly.py:244-250).
gap: No key candidates are ranked by value overlap; the user names the key (assembly.py:223-227). There is no '001' vs 1 repair, no whitespace, case or '.0' normalization, and no check for float IDs that lost precision. Fuzzy keys are deferred (V2_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md:95). None of this is reachable on screen (gaps[6], gaps[63]).

name: Change map: see the combined table before committing
evidence: The join preview draws a row flow: rows in the table, rows with a partner, rows after the join. The caption counts matches, rows left with blanks and the file's unmatched rows (data_previews.py:168-200). What is recorded is what was previewed (data_previews.py:153-154).
gap: There is no live table preview with the seam marked, no styling that separates merge-caused blanks from missing measurements, no column-origin map beyond rename counts, and no stacked-weights warning. The preview has no control on screen (gaps[63]).

name: Stack, and stack-then-link
v2_engine_at: none (a grep of turbotab/core and turbotab/server finds no stack or concat assembly)
evidence: assembly.py implements joins only (assembly.py:1-31). The DoD's minimal assembly covers joins (V2_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md:40-42); deep assembly (fuzzy keys, conflict resolution) is deferred (:95). Neither line names stacking.
gap: There is no way to stack files, for example to pool NHANES cycles, and no grouped stack-then-link. This is an accidental loss, not a ruling.

name: Identifiers and bookkeeping withheld from the predictors
evidence: The roles include identifier, cluster, design, flag, time and excluded (decisions.py:124-127). Only exposure, covariate and energy enter the model (rows.py:30, 39-50). An identifier reading needs values to back it: at least 3 distinct values and a unit structure (BLUEPRINT.md:524-528). The seal groups only by a settled identifier (seal.py:6-16). RolesAsk.tsx:38 draws the roles.
gap: Per-column confirmation and the attention markers are not drawn; RolesAsk records only a bulk set_roles (gaps[16]). No list says what was held back and why.

name: Working-table card, lineage and undo
evidence: The pipeline banner always shows rows through the flow, the column path, the models and the result (Banner.tsx:1-9). The participant flow gives n at each step (RowFlow.tsx:1-8; rows.py:1317-1356), and the lineage runs from raw columns to the model matrix. Every decision can be reverted; nothing is deleted, only made stale (Record.tsx:778-782; BLUEPRINT.md:118-121, 141-143).
gap: The flow counts rows. Distinct subjects are counted only at the grouped split (rows.py:1867 n_groups) or after rows are combined per unit. Undo is one decision at a time, with no multi-step 'Back to here'.

name: Audit summary metrics
evidence: Column summaries hold n_missing and n_unique (datastore.py:97-108), plus mean, sd, quantiles and the most frequent value (datastore.py:1772-1773). The banner shows rows and columns (derive.ts:288-309). ColumnPicker shows dtype, distinct count and missing count per column (ColumnPicker.tsx:154-157).
gap: No tiles for total missing %, numeric or categorical counts, or duplicate rows.

name: Cardinality analysis
evidence: Every column carries a dtype class (numeric, integer, boolean, categorical, datetime, text) and n_unique (datastore.py:99-102), and ColumnPicker draws both (ColumnPicker.tsx:154-157). Constant columns are a finding with a lever (finding_words.py:188-195). Identifiers are proposed from unit counts (rows.py:1041-1043, 1151).
gap: No per-column cardinality-class table (binary, low, moderate, high).

name: Data types and validity, including mixed-type detection
evidence: Text counts as numbers when at least 80% of it parses once missing marks (SAS '.', 'n/a', spreadsheet errors) and censoring marks ('<0.01', '>x') are set aside (repairs.py:567-640). The repairs read_numbers, thousands and decimal_comma are offered with a methods sentence (repairs.py:29-30, 810-850). Repairs.tsx draws them.
gap: None material.

name: Missing-values detail
evidence: ColumnPicker shows missing counts per column (ColumnPicker.tsx:157). The missing-values question can leave mostly blank columns out first (decisions.py:684-690). Its preview notes say which blanks likely mean 'not asked' and what complete cases cost (coach.py:295-325). The decision is deferred to that question, as in Classic. MissingAsk (ChoiceQuestions.tsx:210) draws it.
gap: No missingness table sorted by count and no >50% warning.

name: Duplicate-row detection
evidence: No finding, summary or repair counts exact duplicate rows. The import_doctor checks that v2 runs do not include it (ml/import_doctor.py:315-927).
gap: No duplicate-row count, sample or removal.

name: Numeric statistics with IQR outlier flags
evidence: Mean, sd, min, quartiles, median and max are computed per column (datastore.py:1772-1773), but no component draws them. The table-window and histogram routes have no caller (gaps[8]). v2 deliberately does not flag by generic outlier fences: 'no generic outlier rule can tell them apart' (plausibility.py:623-626; teaching/content.py:162-167).
gap: Nothing describe()-like is drawn. Skewness is not computed. There are no IQR callouts; the absence of IQR flags is a design stance, not a ruling.

name: Suggested one-click cleaning actions
evidence: A constant column's finding routes to roles as 'Mark as excluded' and is settled once those columns hold a non-predictor role (finding_words.py:188-195; repairs.py:1574, 1598-1599). Stale results propagate through graph keys (BLUEPRINT.md:139-146).
gap: No duplicate-row drop. Constant columns are excluded through the roles card rather than with a one-click drop.

name: Exit assurance sign-off
evidence: The seal states its basis (grouped, one row per unit, abandoned or undetermined) and what a holdout of each size can measure (seal.py:6-23, 31-33). The participant flow and the lineage carry losses of rows and columns (rows.py:1317-1356; Lineage.tsx). Each repair and the turn appear as a Record sentence.
gap: There is no consolidated 'surprises' list covering subjects vs rows, people lost, columns removed, never-measured columns and value repairs. The seal plan's floor, labels and n_measured/n_analyzed are unread on screen (gaps[15]). Ingest warnings are not drawn.

name: Analysis goal: Prediction or Hypothesis Testing
evidence: set_purpose (prediction or inference) is asked with no default (PurposeAsk, FactQuestions.tsx:239). The purpose scopes the seal, the imputation, the shelf and the evaluation (BLUEPRINT.md:447-453). The inference lane covers declared estimands, OLS, logistic, ordinal, Cox, mixed models, GEE and design-based estimation (V2_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md:52).
gap: The inference results (Table 2 and the effects) are not drawn yet (gaps[41]).

name: Target dtype diagnosis and in-the-open boolean repair
evidence: The binary-text repair offers one option per level, and the user picks which value becomes 1 (repairs.py:25-26, 483-525). The event level is chosen, never guessed (SetEvent, decisions.py:848-851; EventAsk, SequenceQuestions.tsx:93). One rule says which tasks an outcome may take, and other answers are refused (structural.py:20-22).
gap: None material.

name: Task-type detection with confidence, and an override
evidence: The detection carries a confidence and a sentence that states its evidence (target.py:15-60). Ordinal is a task that v2 actually fits with proportional odds (decisions.py:55; models/ordinal.py), where Classic only warned. The order and scale follow-ups are asked (structural.py:16-22). Detection never pre-selects below high confidence (BLUEPRINT.md:71-72). TaskAsk (FactQuestions.tsx:176) draws it.
gap: The outcome histogram, the skew numbers and the outcome unit are served but unread on screen (gaps[23]).

name: Feature picker
evidence: Columns get roles, not a flat multiselect: exposure, covariate, energy, identifier, excluded and others (decisions.py:126-127). Roles are proposed with a reason, and a homogeneous family can be confirmed as one block (rows.py:5-9; BLUEPRINT.md:578-583). There is no first-N cap. The shelf states the concern at p≥n (elastic_net.py:83-89; boosted_trees.py:57-61). RolesAsk.tsx:38 draws it.
gap: Per-column confirmation and categorical proposals are not drawn (gaps[16]).

name: Subject/participant declaration
evidence: The grain, unit and repeat-kind questions are bespoke (GrainAsk, SequenceQuestions.tsx:156). The seal records 'abandoned' when each row is said to be a unit while an identifier repeats, and 'undetermined' for 'I don't know'. Both are drawn as exploratory, never as a clean lock (seal.py:6-23). A grouping identifier needs confirmation (BLUEPRINT.md:529-532).
gap: None material.

name: Test-set lockbox sealed at upload
evidence: The seal is grouped or chronological, stratified and seeded (rows.py:12-13; seal.py:25-30). Options are ordered by the precision a holdout of that size gives (seal.py:31-33). Scores stay withheld until open_seal, which happens once; a redraw needs a recorded reseal (seal.py:34-51). The seal is purpose-scoped: inference uses every eligible row (BLUEPRINT.md:447-449). Holdout 0-0.4, k-fold, repeated k-fold, bootstrap or internal-external validation (decisions.py:726-735). SealAsk, LiveSeal and OpenSeal draw it.
gap: Bootstrap, nested and internal-external validation cannot be chosen on screen (SealQuestions.tsx:33; gaps[15]).

name: Cohort runs (analyze one group, then the next)
evidence: 'Does it work as well in women?' becomes subgroup performance with intervals on one model (evaluation.py:13-15, 308-317; decisions.py:1627). 'Is the relationship different?' becomes declared effect modification with RERI and a heterogeneity test (interaction.py:1-30). v2's 'cohort' stage is the participant flow, not group runs (rows.py:10-11).
gap: There are no per-group branches, no group-by-group plan table, and no pre-split warnings about multiplicity or unequal sizes. Restricting to one group is possible only with an eligibility rule. Subgroup and modification results are not drawn (gaps[56], gaps[40]).

name: Configuration invalidation and provenance
evidence: Each stage is keyed by sha256 of its upstream keys and the decision slots it reads, so a changed target or feature set makes the downstream stale with no manual lists (BLUEPRINT.md:139-146). Every answer is appended to decisions.jsonl (BLUEPRINT.md:114-121). An outcome change after the seal is refused until a reseal (seal.py:37-42). The banner veils stale segments (Banner.tsx:6-9, StaleVeil).
gap: None material.

name: Leakage-safe EDA scoping
evidence: Explore runs after the seal, on training rows under prediction (explore.py:4-6). The shelf is ranked on training rows only, and its basis line says so (modeling.py:117-126). Preview coach notes never read a sealed row (coach.py:21-25). Pre-seal findings are drawn (Findings.tsx).
gap: The explore stage is never fetched by the frontend (gaps[57]).

name: At-a-glance tiles and a data-sufficiency verdict
evidence: The heuristic verdict is replaced by Riley et al.'s minimum sample size under prediction, and by rows and events per parameter under inference (sample_size.py:3-51; linear.py:11-13). The shelf ranks 'Riley minimum n first' (MODELING_SEQUENCE.md:140). Each family's row-count concerns are drawn (Shelf.tsx:25-41; boosted_trees.py:52-61).
gap: The Riley floor (sample_size.*) is unread on the models card (gaps[22]). There are no rows, features or missing tiles.

name: Auto-generated findings (problems), each with a remedy and a manuscript sentence
evidence: Explore findings each tie a claim to a lever: outcome relationship, outcome distribution and imbalance, near-zero variance, p>n, collinear pairs, and missingness across groups (explore.py:8-20). A skewed outcome asks its scale (structural.py:16-22). Imbalance offers an in-fold correction followed by recalibration (levers.py:29-35). Near-singularity is stated at the fit (linear.py:32-80). Repairs carry methods sentences (repairs.py:9-13).
gap: There is no target-leakage scan; nothing in turbotab/core flags a near-perfect proxy of the outcome. There are no feature-skew findings, by design (structural.py:33-36), and no target-outlier finding. Unresolved findings do not become Discussion limitations. Explore findings are not drawn (gaps[57]).

name: Opportunity findings
evidence: A no-predictor baseline and a regression-with-splines benchmark are always fitted (evaluation.py:6-10; MODELING_SEQUENCE.md:140). The shelf's order expresses which families suit the data (base.py:158-176), and the Shelf draws that order (Shelf.tsx:19-41).
gap: There are no positive-signal findings (strong linear signal, non-linearity, high n/p, balanced classes) that route to a family before fitting. The evaluation stage is not drawn (gaps[56]).

name: Data snapshot and column inspector
evidence: A table-window route and per-column summaries exist (data.py:39; datastore.py:1718-1773), but no component calls the window (gaps[8]). The table_focus view appears only inside decision previews (views/TableFocus.tsx). ColumnPicker shows dtype, distinct and missing (ColumnPicker.tsx:154-157).
gap: No browsable first-rows view and no per-column inspector with a sparkline, stats and that column's open findings.

name: Target distribution views
evidence: target_info serves an outcome histogram (target.py:12). Explore's outcome_distribution finding routes a rare class to the imbalance lever. Under both purposes the view is recorded as looked at, the forking-paths disclosure (explore.py:22-31, 485-514). The eligibility question deliberately withholds the outcome's distribution (coach.py:27-28).
gap: The histogram and skew fields are unread (gaps[23]), and the explore outcome view is not drawn (gaps[57]).

name: Feature distribution gallery
evidence: A histogram route exists with no caller (gaps[8]). Distribution views draw only the columns a decision touches, at most 12 (BLUEPRINT.md:279-280).
gap: No paginated gallery with filter pills, and no switch to a wide-data summary.

name: Outlier prevalence heatmap and outlier-method choice
evidence: No IQR, z-score, MAD or percentile comparison and no outlier-method setting exist in turbotab/core; 'IQR' appears only in omics filter labels (levers.py:623; explore.py:646). v2 states that 'no generic outlier rule can tell [impossible from extreme] apart' (plausibility.py:623-626; teaching/content.py:162-167). It uses plausibility tiers instead (C02-21).
gap: There is no descriptive outlier comparison. This is a design stance, not a BLUEPRINT/DoD ruling.

name: Missing-data bar and co-missingness pattern matrix
evidence: The set_missing preview shows a table and a row flow with notes on blank shares and complete-case cost (coach.py:295-325). Explore compares missing shares across sociodemographic groups (explore.py:17-20). The cohort stage counts the rows complete cases would drop (stages/__init__.py:440-441).
gap: No co-missingness pattern matrix. The complete-case loss comparison and the group comparison are not drawn (gaps[66], gaps[57]).

name: Informative-missingness test
evidence: v2 offers missing indicators and blanks as a level, in-fold (pipeline.py:16-22). It flags blanks that 'likely mean not asked' (coach.py:316). Under inference these are blocked and recorded (methods/missing.py:24-28).
gap: No test compares the outcome between rows where a column is missing and rows where it is present (BH q-values). Under prediction such a test would be an outcome view to record.

name: Correlation matrix and top pairs, with every cap disclosed
evidence: Explore flags nearly collinear pairs at |r|≥0.90. The pair scan is skipped above 500 numeric predictors, and the finding says so (explore.py:60-61, 450). Caps state their bounds (explore.py:57).
gap: No heatmap, no Spearman option, no threshold control and no top-N pairs table. Not drawn (gaps[57]).

name: Features vs target gallery
evidence: For each continuous predictor, the outcome is drawn as binned means or event shares over tenths, on training rows under prediction. Opening it records view_outcome, and a lever pulled afterwards is disclosed as outside the corrected score (explore.py:10-11, 22-35, 416-421).
gap: The explore stage and view_outcome are not drawn or emitted (gaps[57], gaps[68]).

name: Feature Explorer
v2_engine_at: turbotab/core/consequences.py (RelationshipView, used by decision previews only)
evidence: The relationship view kind renders only inside previews such as energy adjustment (views/Relationship.tsx; models/previews.py:3-13). No route lets a user pick any X × Y colored by a third column.
gap: No free scatter explorer.

name: Suggested interactions (mutual-information gain)
evidence: After the fit, interactions among the top inputs are ranked by Friedman's H, by size on the model's scale (explain.py:42-47). Under inference, interactions are declared objects with RERI (interaction.py:1-35).
gap: No pre-model suggestion of interaction pairs. The H ranking and the modification results are not drawn (gaps[35], gaps[40]), and the explain stage cannot be requested from the UI (gaps[37]).

name: Cluster structure: k-means scored against a shuffled null
v2_engine_at: none (turbotab/core/consequences.py:28 names an 'embedding' view only as future work)
evidence: No KMeans or clustering module exists in turbotab/core. Classic's ml/clustering.py could be imported (BLUEPRINT.md:57-59), but nothing does.
gap: No cluster sweep, null comparison, stability (ARI) or profile, and no embedding view kind.

name: Macro shape: variance profile and PCA biplot
evidence: A grep for PCA in turbotab/core finds only a note (consequences.py:28) and teaching text (teaching/content.py:216).
gap: No scree plot or biplot.

name: UMAP embedding
evidence: No UMAP in turbotab/core (grep).
gap: No non-linear embedding view.

name: Persistent homology (diagram and barcode)
evidence: No persistent homology in turbotab/core (grep for homology, ripser, giotto).
gap: No persistence diagram or barcode.

name: Mapper graph
evidence: No Mapper in turbotab/core (grep).
gap: No Mapper graph.

name: 'What your data is telling you' coaching layer
evidence: Findings are ranked critical, warning, info (stages/findings.py:47). At most three cards are pushed; the rest are counted and typed, and same-kind findings share one paged card (Findings.tsx:1-12, 22, 111-112; finding_words.py:890-902; BLUEPRINT.md:288-289).
gap: No grouping by category, no 'opportunities' count and no leakage-first ordering, because there is no leakage finding (C02-03).

name: Physiologic plausibility check with unit inference
evidence: The improbable tier uses real NHANES 2017-2018 weighted adult percentiles. Children are judged by CDC 2000 growth-chart z-scores. Total energy is not treated as physiology. A diastolic pressure of 0 is handled per the NHANES documentation (plausibility.py:1-34). Units are inferred with Classic's reader (plausibility.py:35-37). A unit is proposed but stated only once confirmed (units.py:1-23). Findings and repairs are drawn (Repairs.tsx).
gap: No clinical-guideline threshold overlays. A column holding values in another unit is asked, not converted (plausibility.py:614-615).

name: Residual normality (Q-Q plot and Shapiro-Wilk)
evidence: No Q-Q plot or Shapiro-Wilk in turbotab/core (grep). Inference intervals are HC3, CR2 or bootstrap, which do not rest on normal residuals (linear.py:1-9; effects.py:16-18).
gap: No residual normality diagnostic.

name: Variance inflation factors (VIF)
evidence: At the fit, a Belsley scaled condition number of 1,000 or more names the columns in the dependency (linear.py:32-80; modeling.py:1836-1841). Fitted concerns are drawn on the Shelf (Shelf.tsx:25). Compositions that sum to 100% and nested totals are design warnings, drawn under the lineage (pipeline.py:922-945; LiveScenes.tsx:228). Explore flags pairs at |r|≥0.90 (explore.py:60). VIF exists only in the causal lane (models/causal.py).
gap: No per-feature VIF table before modeling, and moderate collinearity (condition number below 1,000) goes unstated.

name: Influence diagnostics (leverage and Cook's distance)
evidence: Leverage and Cook's distance are computed on the actual analysis model, matching R's hatvalues and cooks.distance (effects.py:39-44). A recorded response (keep_labeled or without_influential) is available (decisions.py:1381-1395).
gap: Inference only. The diagnostics and respond_diagnostic are not drawn (gaps[43], gaps[68]).

name: Diagnostic narration, next steps and run-vs-refusal honesty
evidence: A refusal is a 409 carrying its exits and is never recorded (BLUEPRINT.md:122-123). Refusal.tsx draws it. Skipped and not-applicable steps show their reasons (StatedSkip.tsx; interview.py:67, 160). Explanations are withheld below a performance floor, with the reason (explain.py:53-55). Each finding's lever routes to its question (Findings.tsx:5-7).
gap: The LLM 'Deep Analysis' part is dropped by ruling (V2_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md:96).

name: Table 1 (publication summary)
v2_engine_at: none (turbotab/core/export/tables.py:1-16 has Table 2 and the performance table only)
evidence: The export's results tables are Table 2 with its appendix under inference and the performance table under prediction (export/tables.py:1-16). No stratified descriptive table exists in turbotab/core.
gap: No Table 1, no tests chosen by normality, no SMD, and no CSV or LaTeX output.

name: Width and size regime adaptation
evidence: Ingest is out of core and UI reads are DuckDB queries (BLUEPRINT.md:99-104). Wide data shows only what a choice touched, at most 12 columns (BLUEPRINT.md:279-280). Wide fits use float32 (models/wide.py). Explanations are capped by cells (explain.py:106). The DoD sets speed gates at 500 × 20,000 and 1,000,000 × 30 (V2_DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md:74-75).
gap: None material.

name: Engine EDA actions that v1.0.0 does NOT surface (for the comparison)
evidence: Classic never showed these, so this is not a loss. v2 has surfaced analogs: target_profile becomes target_info (target.py); collinearity_map becomes explore collinear pairs (explore.py:450); data_sufficiency_check becomes Riley (sample_size.py); missingness_plan becomes the mechanism-routed missing card (decisions.py:691-695); imbalance_advice becomes the imbalance lever (levers.py:29-35); cohort_split_guidance becomes grain and the seal basis (seal.py:6-23).
gap: None to close. leakage_scan has no v2 analog (see C02-03).

name: Skip, Reset and 'When to use' guidance
evidence: There is no feature-engineering page to skip. Construction is a step of the modeling sequence (MODELING_SEQUENCE.md:138), and no construction is the default. Each lever option carries customary and sound labels and a rung (explore.py:81-88). Every decision can be reverted (Record.tsx:778-782).
gap: None beyond C03-02 (the levers are not drawn).

name: EDA-driven recommendations
